name: Kooka Kurino
source:
She is Shizuka's niece. Since she hadn't been able to see Shizuka for the past few years, she had been feeling very lonely. She loves Shizuka very much.

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage3070.html]official site[/url]]
